overview: The Community Development Board recommended two proposed Planned Development District rezonings at 243 Mystic Avenue and 100 Winchester Street to the City Council. The board also continued public hearings on a site plan review for H Mart and proposed municipal zoning ordinance amendments.

items.title: 243 Mystic Avenue Planned Development District Rezoning
items.summary: The board voted to recommend approval to the City Council for a proposed zoning map and ordinance amendment establishing a Planned Development District for a life science facility at 243 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: 285–295 Middlesex Avenue (H Mart) Site Plan Review
items.summary: The board voted to continue the site plan review for 285–295 Middlesex Avenue to August 16, 2023.

items.title: 100 Winchester Street Planned Development District Rezoning
items.summary: The board voted to recommend approval to the City Council for a proposed Planned Development District rezoning covering 96–104 Winchester Street.

items.title: City Council Petition for Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: The board reviewed proposed municipal zoning ordinance amendments regarding motor vehicle use special permits, board referral procedures, and inclusionary housing rules, continuing the hearing to August 16, 2023.

items.title: Administrative Business, Approval of Minutes, and Staff Updates
items.summary: The board accepted the meeting minutes from June 7, 2023, deferred officer elections, and received updates on upcoming agenda items from planning staff.
